answer: Beacon-bound enclave vault (BBEV): each agent’s identity is a TPM-sealed vault key. Every epoch, a random beacon nonce must be signed inside the vault and chained into a monotonic crystal counter; peers accept one crystal per vault per epoch and reject forks. Cloning an existing agent requires extracting the sealed key or forging the counter; creating N sybils requires N distinct enrolled enclaves kept online. Honest cost is one vault plus one signature per epoch.
